info.title: credfeto-build-dotnet
info.description: Credfeto Build MCP .NET server: restore, build, test and coverage over stdio MCP

options.name: --self-test
options.description:
Builds the service provider and resolves every dependency, then exits: 0 when that works, 1 with
a one-line reason on stderr when it does not. Starts no MCP transport, reads no input and opens
no file or network connection; the repository is only located (git runs when BUILD_MCP_REPO_ROOT
is unset and /workspace/repo is missing), never read.
